evidence.notes: NotificationActionHandler is a user Apex callback interface; Test.testNotificationActionHandler dispatches executeAction locally and returns the handler result.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingNotificationHandlerEvidenceTest { private class Handler implements Messaging.NotificationActionHandler { public Messaging.ActionResult executeAction(Messaging.ActionableNotification notification) { return new Messaging.ActionResult.Builder().withSuccess(true).withMessage(notification.getActionIdentifier()).build(); } } @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.ActionableNotification note = new Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder().withActionIdentifier('open').build(); Messaging.ActionResult result = Test.testNotificationActionHandler(new Handler(), note); System.assertEquals(true, result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('open', result.getMessage()); } }
